title: Thithikudhe
desc: Separated at youth, Chinnu and Anuradha, two childhood friends turned lovers, reunite years later in an unexpected turn of events..

title: Swayamvaram
desc: Initially at odds, Venu and Anu find themselves in love when they keep meeting each other due to a common friend, Bose, who incidentally is also in love with Anu.

title: Engal Aasan
desc: Mahendran, a bank officer, is transferred to another branch to control the fraudulent activities of a gangster. However, he suffers a severe setback when the latter burns down the entire bank.

title: Bagheera
desc: A psycho killer creates an application to kill women who get a complaint about cheating on their man. However, his life changes when he meets a psychology student.

title: Thimiru Pudichavan
desc: Murugavel, a police officer, learns that his younger brother is a petty criminal working for a local gangster. When he tries to bring about a positive change in him, the brother tries to kill him.
